name: XO Fun
subtitle: Tic Tac Toe
tagline: A clean, fast, friendly take on the classic game of Tic Tac Toe — quick to pick up, fun for every age.
description: XO Fun is a simple, polished version of the game everyone already knows. Tap to play, race a friend, and start a new round in a single tap — no sign-ups, no clutter, just the game.
Built to be family-friendly and safe for kids: it's free, easy to use, and designed with children's privacy in mind.
features: Fast, tap-to-play classic Tic Tac Toe

name: Four Up Duel
subtitle: Connect Four
tagline: A clean, fast, friendly take on the classic game of Connect Four — play a friend or duel the AI.
description: Four Up Duel is a simple, polished version of the classic drop-and-connect game everyone already knows. Name your players, pick a color, and start dropping pieces in a single tap — no sign-ups, no clutter, just the game.
Play head-to-head with a friend on the same device, or duel the AI across Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty.
features: 2-player local mode or vs AI with adjustable difficulty
